Open Shizuku / setup guide
Recovery stops when Shizuku stops or access is revoked. Shizuku in ADB mode usually needs to be started again after a device restart.
Understand the system access risks

Shizuku grants stronger system access than normal app permissions. Authorize only apps you trust.

This feature accepts only ADB or wireless debugging mode. It briefly disconnects and reconnects an already enabled Monica accessibility service. It executes no root commands and does not read or modify vaults, backups, or other app data.

Recovery can fail or briefly interrupt filling. You may need to turn Monica accessibility off and on in system settings. If a concurrent accessibility settings change is detected, recovery stops without overwriting the new settings.

Shizuku started without root usually needs to be started again after a reboot. Turning off enhanced recovery stops future attempts. You can also revoke Monica access in Shizuku.
